items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Slam got with him for a while with Everett Barksdale, but it just didn't go.

ctx.x: Tell me again about the breakup of the trio.

The only thing I can remember about that was we were workin' I think still at the 3 Deuces -- back again. We were in and out of there. And it was said that there would be a vacation -- we weren't gonna work for four or eight weeks or somethin'. That sounded funny 'cause we were in demand, you know. This was the guy, it was a pity he did this thing, whoever did it, persuaded Tatum that he could make as much money on his own as with the trio, you know. And it fell through so now the trio was gone. They tried to get…
Did this happen while you were in New York?
